theme: Dark Creative Studio (RunwayML / Midjourney Alpha style)

headings.usage: Use Outfit for all primary headings, modal titles, and section headers. Gives a geometric, modern, non-generic tech vibe.

body.usage: Clean legibility for UI text, labels, and paragraph descriptions.

monospace.usage: Use for prompt input text, seed numbers, dimensions, image counts, and MCP server configuration/auth tokens.

app_structure.sidebar: Left-aligned, fixed, width ~64px or 240px (expandable). Contains navigation modes (Text-to-Image, Image-to-Image, Bulk Generation, Settings) and user profile.
app_structure.central_canvas: Takes up remaining width/height. Houses the Masonry Gallery for history, Bulk Queue list, or Reference Upload dashboard.
app_structure.floating_prompt_bar: Fixed at the bottom center of the viewport (z-50). Glassmorphic panel housing prompt input, model selector, aspect ratio, image count, and Generate button.

masonry_gallery.description: Grid layout where items have varying heights but fixed widths (columns). Use CSS columns or a masonry library. Cards should have hover states exposing actions (Download, Copy Prompt, Delete, Regenerate).

bulk_queue.description: A dense list or vertical card stack. Each item shows prompt snippet, style thumbnail, status (Pending, Generating, Complete, Failed), and progress. Global 'Download All as ZIP' action at the top.

floating_prompt_bar.style: backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-900/80 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-2 max-w-4xl w-full mx-auto flex flex-col gap-2
floating_prompt_bar.rules: Never use fully transparent background here. Ensure contrast.

buttons.generate: Pill-shaped, bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-900 hover:bg-white font-medium px-6 py-2 transition-all active:scale-95.
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-700 hover:text-white border border-zinc-700.

reference_upload_zone.style: Dashed border (border-zinc-700), bg-zinc-900/50 hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8

style_preset_grid.card_style: Relative rounded-lg overflow-hidden cursor-pointer border-2 border-transparent hover:border-zinc-500 transition-all aspect-square.
style_preset_grid.label: Absolute bottom-0 w-full p-2 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 to-transparent text-xs font-medium text-white

sliders.style: Thin track (bg-zinc-800), prominent thumb (bg-zinc-300). Used for 'Reference Strength' (Subtle / Balanced / Strong).

dropdowns.rules: Never use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns. Must obscure content behind them.

mcp_settings.style: Card-based layout in Settings view. Display Server URL and Auth Token in disabled input fields (font-mono text-sm) with 'Copy' buttons adjacent. Include short markdown-style instructions for Claude integration.

motion.hover_states: Subtle background lightening (bg-zinc-800 to bg-zinc-700), slight scale up on images.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease.
motion.loading: Pulse animations on queue items; shimmering gradient on the 'Generating...' state of the main button.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px solid borders with low opacity (border-zinc-800) instead of heavy drop shadows to define surfaces.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used selectively on Floating Prompt Bar and Lightbox overlays (backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-900/70).
visual_enhancers.corners: Rounded-xl to rounded-2xl for main panels, rounded-md for small UI elements.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient gradient underlay or text-shadow.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-500).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='generate-image-button', data-testid='style-preset-cyberpunk').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React (.js files, not .tsx) and Tailwind CSS.
Implement the 'Dark Creative Studio' theme utilizing zinc/neutral colors. Avoid generic purple/violet AI gradients completely.
Construct the layout with a fixed sidebar for navigation, a large central canvas for content, and a fixed floating prompt bar at the bottom.

Implement the Floating Prompt Bar with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-900/80). Include prompt input, negative prompt toggle, model selector (Gemini 2.5 Flash / Imagen), aspect ratio picker, and image count.
In the Image-to-Image / Reference workflow, build a drag-and-drop zone. Include a slider for Reference Strength.
For the Bulk Generation mode, build a queue visualization showing individual prompt status (Pending/Generating/Done) and a 'Download ZIP' button.
Build the gallery using a masonry layout. Include hover overlays with actions: Download, Copy Prompt, Delete, Regenerate.
Create the Style Presets grid using the provided image_urls for thumbnails. The grid should visually indicate the selected style.
Build an MCP Settings page displaying the Server URL and Auth Token in read-only monospaced inputs with Copy buttons.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all buttons, inputs, and interactive elements.
Do not use `transition: all`. Specify transition properties explicitly.
Ensure dropdowns and overlays do not have fully transparent backgrounds to maintain legibility.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px subtle borders instead of heavy shadows in dark mode.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) combined with a semi-opaque background color.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS.
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like robots, brains, lightbulbs) for icons. Use proper SVG icon libraries (lucide-react).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, scale effects on click.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components where applicable, customizing them to fit the dark studio theme.
